name: coffee_shop_art_prompts
description: 《Spotlight》咖啡店玩法 2D 美术生成提示词清单（供 Trae Work 逐张生成）。生成保存到 output 指定路径后，运行 python Assets/ConfigTables/apply_ai_art.py 做后处理并覆盖到最终路径。

style_guide.keywords: Flat vector cartoon illustration, 2D mobile game art style, clean bold shapes, crisp outlines, warm cozy color palette of cream, wood brown and warm orange light.
style_guide.forbidden: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
style_guide.transparent_requirement: 人物与道具必须输出带透明通道的 PNG（transparent PNG with alpha channel）。若所用生成器不支持透明背景，请改用纯净的纯品红 #FF00FF 纯色背景，后处理脚本会自动抠图。

assets.size_note: 16:9 横图；若生成器有分辨率上限，则输出 16:9 比例下的最高可用分辨率，不低于 1280x720
assets.prompt: Cozy coffee shop interior background for a 2D game, wide 16:9 composition. A wooden counter bar runs along the bottom third of the image with its top surface edge at about 68% of the image height. The counter area between 15% and 40% of the image width must stay simple and uncluttered (game props will be placed there), and the area around 70-80% of the image width below mid height must stay open (a character stands there). On the back wall: wooden shelves holding cups, jars and small potted plants; a dark green chalkboard menu; a large window on the left with soft daylight; three warm pendant lamps hanging from the ceiling. Flat vector cartoon illustration, 2D mobile game art style, clean bold shapes, crisp outlines, warm cozy color palette of cream, wood brown and warm orange light. No people. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
